argv: const fs=require('node:fs');const {createManagedEphemera}=require('./packages/services/managed-ephemera');(async()=>{const results=[];for(const environment of ['staging','production']){const inventory=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('docs/v5/environments/redis-'+environment+'.json','utf8'));let service;try{service=await createManagedEphemera({inventory,environment,credentialFile:inventory.redis.credentialFile});const healthy=await service.healthy();const lua=await service.client.sendCommand(['EVAL',"return redis.call('PING')",'0']);if(!healthy||lua!=='PONG')throw Error('MANAGED_SMOKE_FAILED');results.push({environment,provider:inventory.redis.provider,serviceId:inventory.redis.serviceId,region:inventory.redis.region,verifiedTls:inventory.redis.tls,ping:healthy,lua,applicationWrites:0});}finally{if(service)await service.close();}}console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:true,purposeOwnedInventories:true,productionAppEnabled:false,results}));})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.code||'SMOKE_FAILED');process.exitCode=1;});
